name: Auroom Aura Outdoor Home Sauna
description: Aura Outdoor Home Sauna The Aura backyard DIY sauna kit offers unbeatable value for those seeking the highest quality outdoor home sauna. Each piece of wood, no matter the size, is meticulously chosen to guarantee exceptional quality. This 2-person sauna boasts unmatched attention to detail and value, with contoured Scandinavian-designed bench seating for a sophisticated and upscale look. Designed for those who enjoy building and creating their oasis of relaxation, Auroom Aura Outdoor Home Sauna offers a gratifying solution for DIY sauna lovers. This sauna is designed with both elegance and function in mind. Its unique two-tiered benching and satin-smooth benches ensure a luxurious and satisfying sauna experience. The benches are expertly constructed with no visible fasteners, showcasing meticulous attention to detail in form and function for maximum value. The Sauna heater is sold separately, Lead times may vary. Unmatched Quality and Craftsmanship The Auroom Aura Outdoor Home Sauna is designed for those who demand the very best in outdoor home saunas. Each piece of wood, meticulously selected for its quality, ensures an unparalleled level of excellence. This DIY sauna kit offers exceptional value, featuring Scandinavian-designed benching that provides a sleek, upscale look. Elegant Design and Superior Comfort The Aura's design is a testament to ergonomic precision and aesthetic beauty. The sauna boasts a two-tiered benching system, allowing bathers to find their ideal position for a thoroughly satisfying sauna experience. The benches are satin-smooth, offering a luxurious touch, and they are free of visible fasteners, enhancing the overall aesthetic appeal. The fully tempered glass front wall creates a spacious and inviting atmosphere, allowing for an open and airy feel. DIY Pride and Satisfaction For the do-it-yourself enthusiast, the Aura sauna is the perfect project. It provides not only the satisfaction of constructing your sanctuary but also the pride of ownership in a high-quality, hand-built sauna. The careful attention to detail in the construction process ensures that each sauna is both functional and beautiful, making it a wonderful addition to any backyard.
